notes.title: Development Update [January 2025]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/8df7db3875527ce53b9f7df55272789ab4f7fc93.png[/img]

[h3]Dear Manufacturers[/h3]

As we step into 2025, we just want to take a moment to thank you for your incredible support and for giving Car Manufacture a chance - it truly means the world to us. This past year marked a huge milestone with our Early Access release, and we couldn’t have done it without you.

Looking ahead, we’ve got tons of ideas and plenty of work to do, but our commitment remains the same: improving the game step by step to make it the best experience possible.

First up, the storage conveyors we teased earlier are still in development, but after all the Christmas and New Year hustle, they should finally be ready this month. We’re also actively squashing reported bugs and rolling out some much-needed quality-of-life improvements.

Now, let’s talk about what’s coming next!

[h2]Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/3af1adfd77664931927448c427ee96b1309c2d93.png[/img]
We're finally bringing maps and locations into Car Manufacture! Through the office view, you'll access the map UI, where key points of interest will be marked with pins. But this isn't just a visual upgrade - it's the foundation for major upcoming mechanics like part production, material shopping, and even opening your own dealerships. In short, it's a major step towards pushing the world of Car Manufacture into a more advanced and dynamic stage.

[h2]Factions[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/8ebb875efa8ce485f28da3887124cc770d0e3dc6.png[/img]
Each location on the map isn't just a place - it's a territory controlled by factions. Your reputation with these groups will shape your business strategy. Will you play it clean and align with corporate suits? Or take a more "unconventional" route with the mafia? Maybe you'll curry favor with the government and military? Or, if you're feeling extra adventurous, make contact with UFOs.

But beware - factions don’t always get along. You can’t be in everyone's good books at once. Your choices will open doors to exclusive rewards, but they’ll also lock others. Choose wisely - because who doesn’t love a bit of business intrigue?

[h2]Quests[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/e6bbbbe13ce074fd467c1d6ba9922b24e81d2136.png[/img]
So, how do you actually interact with these factions?

We've are introducing two types of quests:
[list]
[*] Main Quests - Big, story-driven missions where you can only have one active at a time. Choose your path, uncover a connected narrative, and shape the future of your factory.
[*] Side Quests - Fast, flexible, and all about opportunity. Take on as many as you want, tackle faction-based challenges, and rack up profits while carving your own path.
[/list]
This system allows us to introduce deep storytelling while still giving you the freedom to run your business your way. Whether you're expanding your empire, rising through faction ranks, or just staying afloat in this ruthless industry, every choice you make will have real consequences.

[h2]Cool, when?[/h2]

We’re not setting any dates just yet - we want to make sure every new feature gets the time it needs to truly shine. Each update will first land on our Public Beta Branch, rolling out at a pace that ensures quality and polish. In the meantime, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/shYJXdT]official Discord server[/url] to chat, share ideas, and connect with the community.

Until next time!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/996627068425a3a598699dea7b6f41c5ce219dc2.png[/img]

[h3]Dear Manufacturers[/h3]

As always, we would like to thank you for all the support and time you’ve put into our game. We’re thrilled to announce that our biggest update yet is on the way! Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming and how it’ll make your gameplay even better:

[b]Storage Conveyor[/b]
We’re implementing hanging conveyors that can transport car parts throughout the factory. You’ll be able to connect any storage container, building and robot, making logistics smoother and more efficient than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/758c6f786bb980969505481bc856eed4c6e22352.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/c710c79c50fccbc874812d7a86d1dec3085a6e29.png[/img]
[b]Additional Improvements and Fixes[/b]
We’ve also tackled some reported issues and are continuously working to optimize the game’s performance.

We’re planning to release it in November, so stay tuned for more details soon. In the meantime, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/shYJXdT]official Discord server[/url] to chat, share ideas, and connect with the community.

Until next time!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/a138bb032d654d70e5eb8005b4b42fe59081adde.jpg[/img]

The latest version brings improvements and new features based on player feedback and internal testing from the public test branch. Here's a comprehensive breakdown of the changes:

[b]New Worker Type: Driver[/b]

[list] 
[*] Transporter workers will no longer be responsible for handling car transportation.
[*] Added a new "Driver" worker type dedicated to car transportation tasks, now integrated into the tutorial for easier onboarding. [/list]
[b]Employee Area & Worker Assignment[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the Employee Area UI, allowing you to assign workers to specific worker zones. Idle or resting workers will prioritize returning to their designated area.
[*] Worker assignment to Employee Areas is limited based on the objects within the zone. A new "Worker Assignment Capacity" item effect increases the number of workers that can be assigned to an area.

[list]
[*] Quality Station: Now clickable in Play Mode, allowing automatic car operations similar to the parking UI.
[*] Paint Station: Clickable in Play Mode for car color selection, with a color randomization toggle.
[/list]
[b]Logistics[/b]

[list]
[*] Workers are now assigned tasks based on proximity to the task’s starting location.
[*] Refined transport logic to prioritize possible jobs based on distance and support various configuration methods.
[*] Transport jobs now repurpose unused parts from storage or dismantling workshops to prevent resource waste.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some worker models and icons.
[*] Fixed a bug where bankruptcy would overwrite save files upon exiting to the main menu.
[*] Fixed issues in logistics related to looping and mismatches in ordered quantities.
[*] Fixed missing translations in automatic car operations for the parking UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update [May 2024]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/c00fbb8727c09a5df28c7c133be561da3f24b2ef.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=PiGGkVJKUAg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Dear Manufacturers,[/h2]

Long time no see, but fear not, we are still there and working hard towards the release.

Keep in mind that we are a very small studio, consisting of only two people. Sometimes we cannot devote our time to keep everything in check as we would like. However, we do take time to hear your opinions and consider your feedback.

We are now working closely with our QA Team fixing final bugs and tweaking the game balance.

Without further ado, let's see what has changed since the last playtest.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
The game introduction is now extended. It provides more helpful information and now includes object removal, sales, technology, and research. On finishing it, you are ready to conquer any of the Challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/1017a2aad75befb7a7902f2267e7223aeaf4be7e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Challenge (ex-Scenario)[/h3]
There are a few sets of challenges awaiting you, featuring some non-standard elements. You've inherited a parking lot, but be quick with selling these goods, as the thief is prowling the local area. Or perhaps you are interested in ensuring the highest quality of cars for the UFO, risking your workers' lives and your warehouse supplies. Sounds fun? We got more!

[h3]Free Play[/h3]
The good old standard mode. Customize your settings and rules. Take your time and relax, exploring different maps, discovering over 60 various car models and upgrading your factory to its fullest potential.

[h3]Workers[/h3]
We've decided to replace the previous stats system with a simpler, yet more intuitive and precise leveling system. Unlock the Employee Zone, make room for rest and place new fun items that will make your workers even more effective. Consider every worker's level, energy, happiness, and incentives to ensure perfect harmony within your factory. Or just exploit it for the money, I guess?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/0ccd2955a5abad8e118d3ddb6bc446fdb7e50f9d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Technologies[/h3]
Some of the latest conveniences in the Tech Tree are the visuals of upgrade effects, now combining a few entries of the same type. Furthermore, some techs now require additional conditions, allowing for a smoother transition toward the mid and late-game instead of relying heavily on factory finances.

[h3]Help Tables[/h3]
With the more advanced technologies, we introduce new gameplay features into the game. Whenever you feel lost, you can access the Help Tables, which describe pretty much the entire game.

[h3]Game Summary[/h3]
After the game, discover more details about your journey with the brand-new UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/af635a83b5263248c7931d70261cef9795bc0b3a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Performance[/h3]
We constantly strive for a more stable and optimized game in every given scenario while implementing new features. Human unit avoidance is now enhanced. Also, there is an additional new faster speed mode.


Hope you like it! Tell us what you think.

The game is in a very advanced stage of development, bringing us closer and closer to Early Access. It has been worked on non-stop for a few years now. Unfortunately, we came across some obstacles that made both the Demo version update delayed and dev-to-player communication lacking. In order to fix that we are getting back to the regular devlog series. Every two weeks we will post an announcement showcasing new features, changes and the current state of the game.

[b]CONVEYOR & PRODUCTION[/b]

As one of the most advanced features in Editor Mode, we strive to make building and modifying conveyors as accessible as possible. We listened to your feedback and made the most requested changes. We have improved the removal of selected segments as well as the accuracy of sharp turns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/4e5cc04e7015fa4c06a67772e55ec41843ba3f4c.gif[/img]

When it comes to production itself, we got many surprises. Starting off with two separate paint and quality assurance stations. We also implemented various ways to control ongoing production. Now you can pause/play, as well as order the production of new cars to stop and finish the remaining ones. It will allow players to reuse or delete existing conveyors in a much cleaner and safer manner.

[b]STORAGES & ORDERS[/b]

Our main goal here was to make it more logistic-oriented and less of a clicker-type game. We replaced storage slots with a bunch of different types of containers. Those can store up much more resources than before, allowing for better clarity while setting up your storage zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/464c24c71518223fcbda6485314d6870c0a8c5b2.gif[/img]

The previous Transport Link system is replaced by a brand new Ordering feature. With the use of the new storage's UI players can now create their own orders definition of buying and transport. It's an open-ended system that allows us to add more depth to the logistic aspect of the game. In the long run, you will fully plan the way your resources move in and out of your factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/194e243909de958888eff232b6d96da5956e329c.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Manufacturers[/b][/h1]
Lately, we've made some significant updates to the [b]Build Mode[/b] system.

[b]Changes:[/b]

Let's have a look at the first category!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/856313e47b8849032d1b81c486d2ec6a31185fb4.png[/img] 
[b][h2]BUILDINGS[/h2][/b]

The [b]buildings [/b]category contains all various types of structures and entrances which are fundamental for our plant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/7c511479df5389160ce2ec4402322b07036be298.gif[/img]

You may ask, what's the purpose behind buildings?

First of all, we didn't want to restrict players to pre-made structures, so you have complete freedom in making your factory look the way you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/6dfedf6416518876c889768d995ac9c04928d221.gif[/img]

Gameplay-wise it allows us to build zones inside, whether they are assembly, storage, research or sales HQ, providing necessary security and power (which are the features we want to explore and expand in the future). notes.title: Devlog #2 - Assembly Station
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/b0881461101a7d328cb98f5e74b99be201b2e8a8.png[/img]
[h1][b]Dear Manufacturers[/b][/h1]
We would like to wish you all the best in 2020!
Let's hit the new year with the comeback of DevLog series!

[h2]Assembly Station[/h2]
[b]Assembly Station [/b]is the type of area that allow us to manufacture cars in the factory.

[h3]Build Requirements[/h3]
Other than money, we need to keep in mind that [b]Assembly Station[/b] can be placed only inside [b]Building[/b]. This way we can provide the necessary [b]power[/b] and [b]security[/b] for the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/1e7e1eb1d0632134747d07fa55d1d99c5b5291a7.png[/img]

[h3]Blueprint[/h3]
Found your place? Great!
Now it is time to decide what kind of car we want to make in our station.
For that purpose we use [b]Blueprints[/b]. Think of those like recipes. Each blueprint contains a list of [b]steps [/b]and [b]resources[/b] that we need to perform and provide in order to successfully assemble our vehicle.

[h3]Objects[/h3]
Bounds of the Assembly Station area define where we can place various types of [b]objects[/b].
Decorations are nice looking but you will also need functional items.
The most important are [b]lockers [/b]that allow a higher number of workers to labour simultaneously in this station. Other objects can also provide [b]stats boosts[/b] and [b]facilitation [/b]making our production go faster, easier and safer.

[h3]Start Production[/h3]
Once we are done with all the necessary steps, we are free to start the production phase!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34061258/9309d7a0843de0e15272ab26b9c8991d4128f2d8.png[/img]

[h3]Expansion[/h3]
Didn't you think you will be limited to the single station production?
You can connect a few [b]Assembly Stations[/b] with each other to make one big [b]Assembly Line[/b]. 
But more on that later.

https://youtu.be/Rw6BnemwUAI
